build_engine_info_bootstrap_server: build an EngineInfoBootstrapServer HTTP server on a host and port for per-rank model info registration
register_transfer_engine_info: register transfer engine info for a tp_rank with session_id and weights_info_dict via HTTP PUT
get_transfer_engine_info: retrieve transfer engine info for a given rank via HTTP GET or in-process method
check_health: check health of the EngineInfoBootstrapServer via GET /health endpoint
close_server: gracefully close the EngineInfoBootstrapServer and stop the daemon thread
